module: Flowgraph node "Activate Vehicles By Distance" (repeat_instant). Every frame, activates the pool vehicles close to a point and deactivates the others (pool:activateByDistanceTo(pos, distance)). pos defaults to the camera position (core_camera.getPositionXYZ). Requires the core_vehicleActivePooling module; the pool object comes from the Create Vehicle Pool node.

work.desc: Determines the focus point and calls activateByDistanceTo.
